**Optimistic calculations about the Witten-Reshetikhin-Turaev invariants of closed three-manifolds obtained from the figure-eight knot by integral Dehn surgeries**

10 pp, 5 sections.

**Abstract.** I calculate optimisticallyasymptoticbehaviorsof the WRT$SU(2)$ invariantsfor the three-manifoldsobtained from the ﬁgure-eight knot by p- surgeries with $p=0,1,2,$$\ldots,$$10$, from which one can extract volumesand the Chern-Simonsinvariantsof these closed manifolds. I conjecturethat this also holds for general closed three-manifolds.

**Outline.** 1 INTRODUCTION; 3 AN OPTIMISTICLIMIT; 4 DEHN SURGERYALONGTHE FIGURE-EIGHTKNOT; 5 VOLUME CONJECTUREFOR CLOSEDTHREE-MANIFOLDS; References
